product_family: Interactive workflow documentation and automation platform. Captures processes with browser extension, creates step-by-step guides, enables team guidance, integrates with enterprise systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday), and offers workflow automation (Tango Agents) and SOP creation tools.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Tango has been SOC 2 Type 2 compliant since June 2022. The company underwent a two-phase audit by MJD Advisors, implementing over 100 security controls and completing four months of Type 2 controls testing with no critical or high severity vulnerabilities.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 1 report passed initial audit conducted by MJD Advisors after implementing over 100 security controls across the organization.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on tango.ai domain. Not listed in trust center certifications section.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Tango does not currently maintain formal HIPAA compliance. The help article states 'Tango does not maintain formal HIPAA compliance, but does follow rigorous data security standards modeled after those requirements.'

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Tango acts as a data processor under GDPR with Standard Contractual Clauses (Module Two) for EEA and Switzerland data transfers. The DPA incorporates EU SCCs as Schedule I-A and includes a UK Addendum (Schedule I-B) for UK data transfers.

certifications.name: TX-RAMP
certifications.proof_quote: TX-RAMP certification listed in Tango Trust Center as completed compliance standard.

privacy.ai_training_note: Tango explicitly states: 'Your data is never used to train, retrain, or enhance any OpenAI models, Microsoft Azure OpenAI, or Gemini foundation models.' The company implements human-in-the-loop controls and built-in guardrails for AI decision-making requiring explicit confirmation for critical actions.
privacy.data_region: AWS (multi-AZ in US; EU data protected under SCCs)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: SSL/TLS encryption; A rating from Qualys/SSL Labs on security applications

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: All data encrypted at rest in databases

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) using non-publicly accessible VPC; daily automated backups with disaster recovery across multiple AWS Availability Zones

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Continuous real-time security monitoring for anomaly detection; automated vulnerability scanning and remediation; annual third-party penetration testing

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Role-based access controls (RBAC); workflow-level permissions management; multi-factor authentication (MFA)

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Incident response procedures documented and available in Trust Center

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Workspace-wide audit logs for activity tracking; audit logging controls verified under SOC 2 Type II

security.name: Data Protection Features
security.value: Live Blur and Secure Blur for PII/confidential information protection; password masking during capture

security.name: Compliance Automation
security.value: Uses Drata platform for continuous monitoring of SOC 2 controls
